class.name: Poki
class.brief_description: What only Poki has (the mobile pill, the ad blocker, signing in); its ads and game events go through [Services].

method.name: is_ad_blocked
method.description: Whether the SDK could not start because the browser blocks ads: the game goes on without them ([method Services.commercial_break] ends at once).

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Whether Poki's SDK loaded and started. [code]false[/code] outside a web game, in a page without the SDK, or with an ad blocker.

method.name: login
method.description: Opens Poki's sign-in. Call it when the player presses a button: the page loads again with the player signed in, and [method Services.get_player_name] gives their name. For an online game, sign in through the Authentication plugin instead ([code]Authentication.sign_in_with("poki")[/code]): it gives the token a server checks with Poki.

method.name: move_pill
method.description: Moves down the pill Poki shows over the game on phones, so it doesn't cover the game's buttons: [param top_percent] of the screen's height plus [param top_px] pixels from the top.
